sentences.text: Barracudasaurus maotaiensis is the sole known species within this dubious genus of Triassic ichthyosaur discovered in China.
The animal possessed elongated, conical teeth in the front of its upper jaw that had a rounded cross-section and were spaced widely apart.
Additionally, the upper jaw bone, known as the maxilla, was short at the front end.
The genus Barracudasaurus was formally described by Jiang and colleagues in 2005.
Barracudasaurus is classified within the family Mixosauridae.
It belongs to the class Reptilia.
This creature lived during the Middle Triassic period.
